title: Protocol before progress: leakage-aware evaluation of AIS trajectory prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.25827v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reported gains in vessel-trajectory prediction from Automatic Identification System (AIS) data are credited to new architectures, but the evaluation protocol is rarely measured as a source of error reduction. We build a leakage-aware protocol with vessel-, time- and region-disjoint splits and apply it to two corpora with different traffic: 31 days of Danish national AIS traffic and 30 days of US Gulf coast traffic off Houston and Galveston. On both, we audit TrAISformer, GATransformer, and controlled AISFormer-inspired reconstructions. Three protocol effects appear in both corpora. First, TrAISformer's best-of-16 oracle decoder lowers error by a factor of 2.1-3.2 relative to greedy decoding. Second, a split that shares vessels lowers its greedy error by 23-25% at one hour, against 2% or less for a compact 0.43 M-parameter encoder. translated_title: 协议先于进展：AIS船舶轨迹预测的泄漏感知评估
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.25827v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：AIS（船舶自动识别系统）数据船舶轨迹预测所报告的性能提升通常被归功于新的模型架构，但评估协议本身很少被当作误差降低的一个来源加以衡量。我们构建了一个泄漏感知的评估协议，采用船舶、时间和区域互斥的数据划分，并将其应用于两个交通状况不同的数据集：31天的丹麦全国AIS交通数据和30天的美国休斯顿与加尔维斯敦附近墨西哥湾沿岸交通数据。在两个数据集上，我们对TrAISformer、GATransformer以及受控的AISFormer启发式重建模型进行了审计。两种协议效应在两个数据集中均出现。首先，TrAISformer的16选1最优oracle解码器相对于贪心解码可将误差降低2.1至3.2倍。其次，共享船舶的数据划分在一小时预测时使其贪心误差降低了23-25%，而对于一个仅有0.43M参数的紧凑编码器，该降低仅为2%或更少。第三，区域互斥划分使TrAISformer在美国数据集上的一小时误差从2.2公里上升至24.6公里，这是因……
tldr: 本文提出一种采用船舶、时间和区域互斥划分的泄漏感知AIS轨迹预测评估协议，并通过在丹麦和美国两个数据集上的审计表明，大模型所报告的性能提升很大程度上源于评估协议中的数据泄漏而非架构创新。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces a leakage-aware evaluation protocol with vessel-, time-, and region-disjoint splits for AIS trajectory prediction, showing that reported gains of large transformer models largely stem from evaluation leakage rather than architectural advances.
